phenomena.why: The total hidden mass determines whether the arms can carry the crate within torque limits.

handle.unmeasurable: The available measuring skill reads total mass but not moments or horizontal load distribution.

phenomena.why: A high centre of mass can increase grasp loading and tipping effects during motion.

handle.unmeasurable: The available measuring skill does not determine the contents' height.

phenomena.why: A loose hidden item can shift during turning or translation and change the load distribution.

handle.unmeasurable: No available measuring skill detects or tracks internal sliding or rolling.
